description: This file defines an Android activity 'SyncAdapterDriver' that serves as a user interface for managing sync adapters, initiating sync operations, binding and unbinding services, and handling associated UI elements and interactions within the sync framework.

classes.name: SyncAdaptersCache
classes.description: A cache for registered sync adapter services, capable of parsing service attributes to retrieve SyncAdapterType instances.

classes.name: MyServiceConnection
classes.description: An inner class implementing ServiceConnection and ISyncContext to manage service binding, communication, and callback handling for sync adapters.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, initializes the sync adapters cache, and registers the cache listener.

methods.name: getSyncAdapters
methods.description: Retrieves all registered sync adapters for the current user and populates the spinner with their display names.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of UI controls based on service connection status.

methods.name: startSyncSelected
methods.description: Initiates a sync operation for the selected account, prompting the user to select an account if necessary.

methods.name: startSync
methods.description: Starts synchronization for a specified account via the bound sync adapter.

methods.name: cancelSync
methods.description: Requests cancellation of ongoing sync operation.

methods.name: onServiceChanged
methods.description: Callback triggered when a sync adapter service is added or removed, to refresh the cached list.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs for account selection when starting sync.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user selection of an account from the list to initiate sync.

methods.name: initiateBind
methods.description: Binds to the selected sync adapter service, establishing communication.

methods.name: initiateUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds from the active sync adapter service.

methods.name: getSelectedSyncAdapter
methods.description: Returns the currently selected sync adapter info based on user selection.
